The '''Tribal Intelligence Depository''' was an archive in the city of [[Orreg]] on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] that existed around [[2974 BBY]]. It was maintained by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], the descendants of a group of stranded [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had settled on Kesh following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The tribal intelligence depository was used to store intelligence on domestic enemies of the Tribe's leadership on the continent of [[Keshtah Minor]]. Prior to the banishment of the outcast [[Parlan Spinner]], the [[Prefect of Police]] [[Takara Hilts]] deposited a [[Enemy of the Order: The record of Parlan Spinner, vandal and would-be revolutionary|detailed report]] on Spinner at the depository.
